_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff Default v3.1.343 / firmware rev27v-followup-331

Initial ordinary inflation keeps prompt load feedback through the startup
transient and the existing response interval between duty changes. Slow loads
retain full pump authority. Smart Const refill requires a fresh pressure-trend
baseline at its actual MAP+5 target.

Regular and High Max preserve the hold+5 refill operand. After pump cutoff,
the valve stays sealed while a fresh whole-beat pressure/rate fit observes
relaxation. The existing 30-second quiet hold begins after the fit is within
hold-2 to hold+1 mmHg and its drift limits. Failure to settle within 60 seconds
stops the sequence and vents. CVP gradually recovers pressure error against
its original deflation ramp; bounded valve travel reaches each decision target
under the existing slew cap. Read-only response/PWM diagnostics retain bench
evidence. Calibration, feedforward, PID gains, valve limits, branch menus,
30-second minimum-rise protection and other safety gates are preserved.

Protected Device D flash/full-state restore and required ten-minute seed213
soak completed all six cycles. Delivery 24,974/24,974 = 100%; native NI
314,830 samples, zero gaps/backtracks, exact mirrors and full-wire CRC pass.
Matched Arm/Wrist CVP deflation RMS improved from 8.04/10.52 to 2.15/2.17 mmHg.
Nine actual production START cycles completed on the wrist cuff/syringe with
ProSim: Regular, Smart, three High Max repeats and Arm/Wrist CVP each with
pulses off/on. Delivery 59,099/59,099 = 100%; 691,750 native NI samples,
native integrity, full-wire CRC, calibration/tuning preservation and safe
cleanup pass. Compile, focused/parity/layout/smoke and release checks pass.

Full physical qualification remains FAIL. Regular and High repeats1/3 pass
the original screens. Smart quiet2.5s error +2.900 and High repeat2 inflation
RMS5.120/quiet+2.154 fail the unchanged gates. Separate serial ordering confirms
pump0/valve100 throughout all five quiet holds; the original Smart host-time
actuator failure remains recorded. CVP startup and pulse-sensitive inflation
screens fail despite better whole-ramp tracking. Supplemental pulse fits do
not replace the original verdicts. Prior valve stationarity/repeatability and
strict-reliability failures remain retained. No SysID/calibration profile adopted.

Actual medium/very-large cuffs, qualified independent pressure/pulse/electrical
faults, physical knob/button/OLED and a second enrolled PC are unobserved.
Rendered-window verification is unavailable because Windows Computer Use
reports native pipe unavailable (os error2). This release is a tested controller
improvement and does not claim full physical, population or clinical qualification.

Default source commit: a0f481bfe49ac74e53aad8687f589f56fade5856.
Valinor remains unchanged. Live calibration files remain local and ignored.
The automatic updater verifies branch-specific URL, size and SHA-256 and uses
the existing fresh IDLE/pump-off/vented installation gate and detached relaunch
supervisor. Firmware alignment uses protected one-Due snapshot/flash/restore.
Unsigned build/publication uses explicit -AllowUnsigned. A first unsigned
installation may require More info -> Run anyway in Windows SmartScreen.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
